simple.summary: יוֹעֶזֶר (Yôwʻezer) means Joezer , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 7.

definitions.full: H3134. Yoezer יוֺעֶ֫זֶר proper name, masculine ( ׳י is a help ;) compare עַזְרִיאֵל עֲזַרְאֵל, אֱלִיעֶזֶר, עֲזַרְיָהוּ, & references) one of David's mighty men 1Chr 12:7 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωζαρα , Ἰωζααρ , ᵐ5 L Ἰεζρααρ ).
